head.text: Boot flash read - 8-bit port, 0 wait states (one byte of a dynamically sized access)

signal.name: state
signal.data: S0 S1 S2 S3 S4 S5 S0 S1 S2 S3

foot.text: Only DSACK0 is asserted, so the CPU treats the flash as an 8-bit port on D31-D24 and runs four of these cycles per long word. Worst case at 20 MHz the flash gets about 62 ns from CE and 32 ns from OE (nCPU_RD) before the latch: an SST39SF040-55 fits, a -70 part does not on paper.
